questions.question: Recently, with which country's ACLEDA Bank has India's UPI partnered?
questions.explanation: India's UPI partnered with Cambodia's ACLEDA Bank to strengthen cross-border digital payments.

questions.question: Who recently launched the AI-designed 'Majorana 2' quantum chip?
questions.explanation: Microsoft launched the AI-designed Majorana 2 quantum chip for advanced quantum computing research.

questions.question: Recently, the Curt Bergfors Foundation of Sweden awarded the 'Food Planet Prize 2026' to the Community Managed Natural Farming initiative of which state?
questions.explanation: Andhra Pradesh Community Managed Natural Farming (APCNF) received the 2026 Food Planet Prize.

questions.question: Who recently became non-permanent members of the UN Security Council?
questions.explanation: Austria, Kyrgyzstan, Portugal, Trinidad and Tobago, and Zimbabwe were elected as non-permanent members.

questions.question: Where was the 73rd Plenary Session of the North Eastern Council held recently?
questions.explanation: The 73rd Plenary Session of the North Eastern Council was held in Shillong, Meghalaya.

questions.question: Which state recently launched 'Operation Delta Hunt'?
questions.explanation: Gujarat Police launched Operation Delta Hunt against illegal infiltration and related activities.

questions.question: Which country was recently appointed as the President of the 81st session of the UNGA?
questions.explanation: Bangladesh Foreign Minister Khalilur Rahman was appointed President of the 81st UNGA session.

questions.question: Which is India's first private university to recently establish the 'IndiaAI Data Lab'?
questions.explanation: Chandigarh University became the first private university in India to establish an IndiaAI Data Lab.

questions.question: What is the base year for the recently released All-India Index of Industrial Production?
questions.explanation: The new IIP series uses 2022-23 as the base year.

questions.question: Where was a massive 1,800-year-old 'Potato Patch' coral recently discovered?
questions.explanation: The giant 1,800-year-old Potato Patch coral was discovered in Lakshadweep.
